# Cuthol

> Cuthol is a local, open-source non-linear video editor built for AI agents. An agent edits through a CLI (`cuthol`) or an MCP server (`cuthol mcp`, 14 tools): a magnetic spine and typed lanes, speech transcription and cleanup, captions, voiceover, loudness and ducking, clip effects and speed ramps, HyperFrames motion graphics composited with alpha, per-frame layout geometry, verification gates, frame previews that match the render, and a journaled undo for every change.

Start an agent with `guide(topic="cuthol")` over MCP, or load the `cuthol` skill (installed automatically into detected agent tools on first run). Diagnostics read `[CUTHOL-Gxxx] what | Suggestion: next step`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/README.md): install, MCP client setup, features, configuration
- [cuthol](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol/SKILL.md): entry skill — the model, workflow, rules, and which category skill to load when
- [cuthol-editing](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol-editing/SKILL.md): spine, lanes, cues, trims, speed and ramps, effects, transitions, colour, envelopes, undo, outside edits
- [cuthol-speech](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol-speech/SKILL.md): transcription, cleanup, verify-cleanup, captions, voiceover, speech providers
- [cuthol-audio](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol-audio/SKILL.md): loudness, voice polish, ducking, beat grid and beat alignment, audio health
- [cuthol-motion](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol-motion/SKILL.md): HyperFrames compositions, the `window.__cuthol` runtime, preview, script errors
- [cuthol-geometry](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol-geometry/SKILL.md): per-frame layout measurement and the geometry query
- [cuthol-review](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol-review/SKILL.md): verification gates, diagnostic codes, monitor frames and sheets, brief lenses
- [cuthol-render](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol-render/SKILL.md): presets, overlay cache, encoders, long timelines, post-render checks
- [cuthol-extensions](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol-extensions/SKILL.md): helpers, processors, effects, transitions, recipes, planners, speech and media providers
- [MCP reference](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/skills/cuthol/references/mcp.md): tool and argument reference

## Optional

- [Architecture](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/blob/main/src/ARCHITECTURE.md): source map
- [Example extensions](https://github.com/HypeAITR/Cuthol/tree/main/examples/extensions): one per extension kind — transitions, film-look clip effects, freeze/fade processors, speed-ramp recipes, montage planners, a caption composition kit — plus command-based speech recognition and voiceover bridges and a local media folder provider
